265:t_2:62.en:
$$早乙女$$
「That's right. That is why the $$ゲッター線$$ seeks the strong.」

265:t_2:63.en:
$$ミチル$$
「Once every 12,000 years, the universe tries to be reborn.」

265:t_2:64.en:
$$武蔵$$
「The force that seeks to vanish and the force that seeks to exist... The two energies collide...」

265:t_2:65.en:
$$早乙女$$
「To erase the force that seeks to exist, the force that seeks to vanish tries to erase the power of life.」

265:t_2:66.en:
$$早乙女$$
「That is what gives birth to $$バアル$$.」

265:t_2:67.en:
$$竜馬$$
「The universe gives birth to $$バアル$$, you say...!」

265:t_2:68.en:
$$ミチル$$
「But life does not perish... Through blood of the beast, mingling of waters, destination of the wind, civilization of fire, and the sun's radiance, it walks the path of $$シンカ$$...」

265:t_2:69.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Tell me! What on earth do those words mean!?」

265:t_2:70.en:
$$早乙女$$
「To think you'd bow your head to me. $$竜馬$$, is that all you are?」

265:t_2:72.en:
$$武蔵$$
「$$シンカ$$ isn't something anyone can teach you. Prove you can reach it by your own power.」

265:t_2:73.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Bring it on. If you're going to say that much, I'll make up my mind.」

265:t_2:74.en:
$$武蔵$$
「That's the spirit. I'll be waiting, $$竜馬$$.」

265:t_2:75.en:
$$早乙女$$
「Those who open the door of $$シンカ$$ will stand against the end of the universe... And that will become the power to overcome the true end that is yet to come...」

265:t_2:77.en:
$$早乙女$$
「12,000 years... Repeat that ten thousand times, and the universe meets its true end.」

265:t_2:78.en:
$$早乙女$$
「That will be the final battle... The force that seeks to vanish and the force that seeks to exist will clash with everything they have...」

265:t_2:79.en:
$$早乙女$$
「It will draw in every parallel world that exists.」

265:t_2:81.en:
$$ミチル$$
「12,000 years, ten thousand times... That makes 120 million years...」

265:t_2:82.en:
$$武蔵$$
「The power that overcomes it... is the pinnacle of $$シンカ$$... In other words, the power of a god...」

265:t_2:83.en:
$$早乙女$$
「Gods and devils... The battle between the higher life forms and $$バアル$$... That is the way to overcome the end...」

265:t_2:84.en:
$$竜馬$$
「A battle of gods and devils... So that's what the $$ミケーネ神$$s were talking about...」

265:t_2:85.en:
$$早乙女$$
「But there is also one who has forgotten the mission of the higher life forms. That one may be the true enemy...」

265:t_2:86.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Hold on, Doc! You're leaving already!?」

265:t_2:87.en:
$$早乙女$$
「$$竜馬$$. I will show you and your comrades a glimpse of the end.」

265:t_2:88.en:
$$武蔵$$
「Don't you die, $$竜馬$$ of this world.」

265:t_3:5.en:
$$アサキム$$
「But what on earth is it for...」

265:t_3:8.en:
???
「Do you want some answer other than that?」

265:t_3:10.en:
???
「Do not forget hope, accursed wanderer. Your journey's end is near.」

265:t_10:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But I don't understand... What on earth for...」

265:t_10:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Just kidding! How unlike me to get all serious!」

265:t_10:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well... in a situation where none of us knows what tomorrow holds, the celebration for the ace pilots will have to wait until next time.」

265:t_10:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That said, I have a dimensional merchant's grit! No matter the situation, the $$Ｄトレーダー$$ stays open for business!」

265:t_10:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now then...! Here's to everyone's bright futures~! Let's give it our all again today... business, business!」

266:t_000:0.en:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「A force approaching our course has been confirmed.」

266:t_000:1.en:
$$田中司令$$
「It seems our long-awaited uninvited guests have arrived.」

266:t_002:0.en:
$$ギミー$$
「I've been waiting for you, $$サイデリアル$$!」

266:t_002:1.en:
$$ダリー$$
「I never imagined a day would come when I'd be saying this.」

266:t_002:2.en:
$$ヨーコ$$
「They've even brought out battleships, so it looks like a decent-sized force.」

266:t_002:3.en:
$$ヴィラル$$
「Let's hurry up and squeeze these guys for a way to get back to Earth.」

266:t_002:4.en:
$$正太郎$$
「S-somehow... our positions are the opposite of usual.」

266:t_002:5.en:
$$葵$$
「It's fine. Those guys took plenty from Earth, after all.」

266:t_002:6.en:
$n
「That's how it is. No need to hold back.」

266:t_002:7.en:
$$甲児$$
「Let's give it everything we've got. Put our grudge from Earth into it too.」

266:t_002:8.en:
$$さやか$$
「You two look scary, both of you!」

266:t_002:10.en:
$$ボス$$
「An even scarier face just showed up!」

266:t_002:11.en:
$$シモン$$
「Let's go, $$サイデリアル$$! You're going to make yourselves useful so we can get back to Earth!」

266:t_003:2.en:
$$隼人$$
「Did you sense an enemy or something?」

266:t_003:3.en:
$$竜馬$$
「No... This is... something much bigger...」

266:t_004:0.en:
$$ミカ$$
「The dimensional boundary line is warping rapidly!」

266:t_004:1.en:
$$凱$$
「This is bad! This is on the scale of a $$時空震動|lc$$!」

266:t_005:1.en:
$$ラルク$$
「$$宇宙怪獣$$ and $$インベーダー#pilot$$s are fighting each other!?」
